1. (Currently amended) A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, the method comprising:
a. providing a finger palette including:
i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and
ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion, wherein the surface portion is configured to receive cosmetic product directly from an applicator tool rather than from a user's finger;
b. securing the finger palette to a finger;
c. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette using an applicator tool;
d. manipulating the cosmetic product on the surface portion using the applicator tool; and
e. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination using the applicator tool.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further including the step of removing the cosmetic product from a container using an applicator tool before depositing the cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein:
a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and
b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, wherein the difference between the first quantity and the second quantity remains on the surface portion of the finger palette.

5. (Original)

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without protrusions extending therefrom, and wherein the surface portion is configured to be scraped by an applicator tool in an uninterrupted motion.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar and is configured to facilitate scraping by an applicator tool without interruption across the surface portion.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion, and wherein the ring portion is configured to be removably and replaceably secured to the finger.
